name: Tekken Corporation
summary: Tekken Corporation engages in the civil engineering and construction work business in Japan, Asia, and internationally. It operates through Civil Engineering, Architectural Construction, Real Estate, Incidental Business, and Other segments. The company develops social infrastructure projects, such as roads, tunnels, bridges, water supply and sewage systems, and riverbank revetments; railroad infrastructure, including railway viaducts, bridges, tunnels, stations, station buildings, and railyards; and construction buildings, such as condominiums, schools, and medical and welfare facilities.
